description: Record a refund on an order: refundedAmount rises by the amount and the reference joins refundReferences. Omit amount to refund everything still refundable (amountPaid - refundedAmount); pass amount in minor units for a part. A full refund also cancels parcels not yet dispatched and puts their stock back. Irreversible. Idempotent by reference. Refused when the order cannot be refunded or the amount is above what is left. To refund the goods of one return, refund_return. Returns the order's id and orderNumber; get_order reads the new state.

amount.description: Partial refund amount in minor units of the order's currency; omit for full refund

reference.description: Refund reference / receipt id; a reference already in the order's refundReferences makes the call a no-op

name: refund_order
title: Refund order
